name: venforce-frontend-react
description: Migração gradual do Portal VenForce para React + Vite, por ilhas: Cliente 360, Central de Gestão Full, Visão (F3), Financeiro (F4).

scripts.build: npm run build:cliente-360 && npm run build:full && npm run build:visao
scripts.build:cliente-360: node scripts/clean-assets.mjs cliente-360-react && vite build --mode cliente-360-react
scripts.build:full: node scripts/clean-assets.mjs full-gestao && vite build --mode full-gestao
scripts.build:visao: node scripts/clean-assets.mjs visao && vite build --mode visao
